operations.content: Hermes MCP client cannot consume TrailCode/Graft 0.25.x deferred tools (tools/list returns empty). Pin @nanonets/graft@0.15.0 via the global install (C:\Users\user\AppData\Roaming\npm\graft.cmd); wrapper .cmd must cd into the indexed repo first (quote paths containing spaces). One server instance covers exactly one repo root.

Neocoder code maps live per project under F:\CD\Opencode\Projects\ (neodev-portal is the main prebuilt one); the Opencode root has no graph, so a TrailCode server pointed at root answers empty. Hermes own map covers skills/memories/scripts/plugins/cron/hooks/platforms/shared.
Sentry MCP needs mcp_servers.sentry.auth=oauth set in config.yaml before hermes mcp login works; a URL-only entry fails login with auth=None. Fix via config set, not remove+add.

hermes mcp test showing Connected with 0 tools can mean a version/behavior mismatch or a missing graph, not a dead server. Always verify MCP code-map servers with a live tools/call query returning real file hits, never tools/list count alone.
